name: lispan_inv_span500_c3_paper_wS_b5
description: Li-SPAN PINN inverse on measured SPAN500 C/10 cycle 3 (Wang et al., Nat. Mater. 2026, Fig. 4a): U0_1..3 and b_1..3 with k0 fixed at the Simanjuntak effective values ('paper' kinetics), Z_CC from the EIS high-frequency intercept, current and capacity axis from the FV calibration (scripts/lispan_span500.py with absolute-step FD: w_S 0.3763 -> 1.2230 A/m2; the current is read from the model_json of the data file, which must come from the same fit). Trust-region LM on the parameters with physics-only fields, as for the Fig. 4b data; networks warm-started from the 0.1 C final-recipe model. Data window Q <= 0.95 x the FV model's end of discharge (138 of 150 points) and PINN window t_end = 0.98 x the fitted FV model's discharge time, so that neither contains the cut-off collapse. Networks from the stage-1 run (forward re-adaptation at the measured current, nominal parameters). param_log_bound 5 (U0 offsets within +-0.5 V; the default 2 clamps U0_3 at -0.2 V, FV optimum -0.224 V).
